text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out with Haru Urara, I'm
about to see
her off at the academy
when...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I just remembered something! In the
shopping
district, I saw a grilled carrot
dish I wanted to eat.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I totally forgot while we were out and
about.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's go get some now! Come on,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Nooo! My tummy says it wants to
eat it
now!
choice_data_list: 次の楽しみに取っておこう

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That smells like carrot curry! It's
dinner time! I
gotta hurry back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! Let's eat the grilled
carrots some
other time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ten seconds after she leaves, I hear a
loud "It
looks so good!" coming from the
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I promised myself I was gonna try
it one of
these days!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I just remembered! The store closes
at night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara runs toward the shopping district at a speed I've never seen from anyone before.
